gates.notes: Company leverage 1.75x; provider ND/EBITDA 2.5x incl. leases. FCF EUR359m vs reported NI EUR367m (~98%). No transaction pending.

bull_points: Dense European laundry network with 35% EBITDA margin and proven inflation pass-through.
Deleveraged balance sheet funding EUR500m buyback.
Low AI and cyclical exposure; diversified across ~30 countries, no NA overlap with US portfolio names.
bear_points: Organic growth slowing toward ~3% as post-inflation pricing fades.
High capital intensity (linen pools) limits FCF conversion vs EBITDA.
thesis_breakers: Leverage back above 2.2x from a large acquisition.
